land.text: 'Later, the Vatsa kingdom was annexed by the Avanti kingdom'; Maniprabha, a great-grandson of Pradyota, ruled at Kausambi as an Avanti prince

successors.note: No year on the page; -451 is Cliopatria's last year for the row and janapada-of-avanti dates its gain c. 450. The page then has Vatsa 'ultimately annexed into Magadha by Shishunaga' (no year; Shishunaga overthrew the Haryankas, c. 413 BCE).

capitals.name: Kausambi (Kosam)
capitals.note: Capital Kausambi (Kosambi), 'on the Yamuna river'; the page links modern Kosam. Coordinates are approximate and mine: Kausambi is not in the gazetteer.

keyframe_review.note: -600..-481. The page gives no area; Cliopatria's 4,015 km2 disc (bbox 81.61-82.35E 25.36-26.13N, centroid 81.96E 25.76N, about 35 km north-east of Allahabad) is a core of the country the page names: 'located to the south of the Ganga river', capital Kaushambi 'on the Yamuna river', infobox 'Allahabad division of Uttar Pradesh'. My correction is a radius of 80 km around Allahabad (about 20,000 km2, my reading); Kaushambi (Kosam) is about 45 km west of Allahabad.

Cliopatria's Haryanka shape from -450 holds all 15 cells of this disc, which the page does not support (Avanti first, Magadha only under Shishunaga); the Haryanka dossier cuts it out.

region.text: Vatsa, 'one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas (great kingdoms)', centred on Kausambi on the Yamuna

ledger.note: 600 BCE: Vatsa enters the map as one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas, with Kausambi as capital. The page gives only 'Established: c. 700 BCE' (infobox) and no date for the Mahajanapada list; -600 is Cliopatria's first year, so the year is a bridge. The earlier life (Nicaksu, 'first' ruler, 8th century BCE; Satanika II, Udayana) is undated on the page.

451 BCE: Vatsa passes to Avanti. 'Later, the Vatsa kingdom was annexed by the Avanti kingdom'; Bhasa has Udayana held prisoner by 'King Pradyota of Avanti'. The page dates neither; Cliopatria's row ends -451 and the infobox 'Disestablished: c. 300 BCE' does not fit the page's own account (Avanti, then Magadha under Shishunaga).

certainty.note: The Ganga bounds the country on the north, but no frontier with Kosala, Kasi, Cedi or Avanti is given.

sources.title: Vatsa
sources.note: Territory, Kausambi, infobox c. 700-c. 300 BCE, Udayana and Pradyota, annexation by Avanti and then by Shishunaga (all undated).

notes: One page for two shapes. Not settled: (1) the page is silent on every date: no ruler is dated, the annexation by Avanti has no year, and the infobox c. 300 BCE end does not match its own text (Magadha's Shishunaga, c. 413-395 BCE on the Avanti dossier). The end -451 is Cliopatria's. (2) Udayana held by Pradyota (Bhasa) and Satanika II's attack on Campa, Anga's capital, are undated and not drawn: no contest events. (3) The Cliopatria disc is far smaller than the Allahabad-division country the page names; the corrected radius is my reading, no area on the page. (4) Cliopatria's Haryanka -450 shape contains the whole Vatsa disc; see magadha-haryanka-dynasty. (5) No wars listed. (6) Gazetteer names wanted: Kaushambi (place).
